slices.notes: Lead note 2026-10-26: a test result counts only if it names the exact test or filter, quotes cargo's 'test result:' line, and comes from a binary rebuilt after your last edit (cargo prints 'Compiling <crate>'; touch the file if it does not). A pass reported without that was found wrong today (D1-778). inference.proto changes rebuild mp-contracts: run cargo clean -p mp-contracts on the shared target before the first build, or the stale-build trap returns old generated code. Do not regenerate the Go bindings: list the buf regen under lead_todo. The switch INFERENCE_OPENAI_PROMPT_CACHE_KEY stays default off with the strict literal parser, and a prompt cache key must never carry or be derived from content (zero data retention): derive it from scope identifiers only.
